Remark
[Compatibility conditions] ↗ thm:parabolic-higher-regularity ↗ thm:mappings-into-better-spaces 1. ch7:7.1.3-rem-4\group Regularity

The time traces satisfy \[ f(0)\in H^{2m-1}(U),\quad f'(0)\in H^{2m-3}(U),\quad \ldots ,\quad f^{(m-1)}(0)\in H^1(U), \] and consequently \[ g_0\in H^{2m+1}(U),\quad g_1\in H^{2m-1}(U),\quad \ldots ,\quad g_m\in H^1(U). \] Compatibility additionally requires every $g_j$ to have zero trace on $\partial U$.
